script.topic: 3 GPU buying myths that waste your money
script.hook: Stop falling for these GPU buying myths before you upgrade your rig.
script.narration: Stop falling for these GPU buying myths before you upgrade your rig. Myth one: More VRAM automatically means faster performance. Extra memory only helps if your games actually use it; otherwise, that extra cash is wasted. Myth two: You need the flagship card to play modern games. Mid-range GPUs often deliver incredible performance for half the price. Myth three: Clock speeds on the box tell the whole story. Architecture and real-world benchmarks matter far more than raw megahertz numbers. Always check independent benchmarks for the specific games you play before dropping your hard-earned cash.

script.hook: That massive Steam leak was real: Thief Remastered is getting an entirely new story campaign.
script.narration: That massive Steam leak was real: Thief Remastered is getting an entirely new story campaign. Nightdive Studios officially confirmed 'The Tarnished Mirror' campaign, just days after a massive Steam achievements leak spilled the title. Many retro PC gamers feared Thief: The Dark Project Remastered would be a simple texture polish, but Nightdive is going way beyond upscaled graphics. They're adding brand-new story content to the classic immersive sim, bringing fresh stealth action to long-time fans. We won't have to wait long for the official details—Nightdive confirmed a full reveal is set for November.
